She holds a smartphone and looks around with a surprised expression. She notices a middle-aged man in a navy blue polo shirt and beige pants leaning against a pillar. They greet each other warmly, laughing and talking in front of the building's glass entrance. (2) The setting shifts to a brightly lit indoor hallway/dressing area. The woman helps the man put on a stylish khaki-colored jacket and dark-framed glasses. They stand in front of a mirror, posing and expressing excitement with hand gestures. The lighting is soft and warm. (3) They arrive at a restaurant branded "TOKIYA." They sit in a well-lit booth with a wooden table spread with elaborate dishes including steak, fish, greens, and desserts. They are seen eating, gesturing towards the food, and holding a smartphone for a video call. Close-up shots show the details of the food being cut and eaten.
